methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: In this paper, a predictive tool for the energy consumption of wheat milling process using multiple linear regression and a new energy performance indicator (EnPI) is proposed.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The model was developed in field conditions in a wheat processing plant located in Cuba.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The food industry is divided into several sectors. Among these, the wheat processing sector is considered as an energy-intensive industry consumer because require high and regular energy supply.

ems_standard.evidence_quote: According to ISO 50001 and ISO 50006 standards, several variables that affect the energy consumption can be introduced to obtain an EnPI (ISO, 2011), (ISO, 2014).

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: To obtain the EnPI, a multivariable linear model was used applying the “multiple regression” tool of the software “Statgraphic”.
